purpose: Bind each current Strategy25 source_sha256 to immutable Exact25 evidence before assigning the next diagnostic lane.

lane_contract.ZERO_SIGNAL_FUNNEL_REQUIRED: Use only when current source is proven identical to immutable evidence whose trade count is zero; diagnose raw_condition -> setup -> qualified -> order_intent -> closed_trade without tuning.
lane_contract.TRADE_BEARING_EXACT_SOURCE_PARITY_REQUIR: Use only when current source is proven identical to immutable evidence with one or more trades; rerun parity before any optimization or promotion.
lane_contract.EVIDENCE_UNRESOLVED: Default when exact source/evidence binding is absent, ambiguous, stale, or mismatched. No replay classification, tuning, promotion, paper, live, registry, ledger, or order mutation is allowed.

decision_rule: For each of 25 strategies, read current source_sha256 from the P5 identity census.
Locate immutable Exact25 evidence carrying the same source identity or a reproducible source manifest that resolves to the same SHA256.
If no exact binding exists, classify EVIDENCE_UNRESOLVED.
If exact binding exists and immutable trade_count == 0, classify ZERO_SIGNAL_FUNNEL_REQUIRED.
If exact binding exists and immutable trade_count > 0, classify TRADE_BEARING_EXACT_SOURCE_PARITY_REQUIRED.
Do not infer the current 13/12 split from historical aggregate counts alone.
next_if_pass: Run zero-signal causal funnel only for ZERO_SIGNAL_FUNNEL_REQUIRED.
Run exact-source parity replay only for TRADE_BEARING_EXACT_SOURCE_PARITY_REQUIRED.
Then run component ablation and disposition: VARIANT / ABSORB / OVERLAY / QUARANTINE / KILL.
next_if_hold: Resolve source/evidence binding only; do not optimize strategies.
